title: Backlog-migration idempotence: durable-status keying, option-aware divergence remedy, and the LCLI-699 core (DEC-172 (4ap)/(4as))
description: Supersedes LCLI-699 under opum-doc DEC-172 (4as). Carries LCLI-699 reviewer-cleared core plus the (4ap)/(4ap)(a) rework (idempotence keys on Quest durable status) plus the Q2 option-sensitive divergence remedy, and REWRITES LCLI-699 scope that (4ar) parked: the doc line cli-surface.md:217 kept the false commit-or-clean arm.

acceptanceCriteria.text: LCLI-699 AC (a), carried: a rerun holding a pending migration record runs at most ONE read-only Quest preview to fingerprint the current source; a digest match exits 0 with the existing receipt plus alreadyApplied: true and applies nothing.
LCLI-699 AC (b), carried: the same rerun WITH --remove-backlog performs the verified archive, then verify, then remove.
LCLI-699 AC (c), carried: a read-only preview whose fingerprint differs from the recorded migrationDigest refuses with the named code backlog.diverged-from-migration, applying nothing.
LCLI-699 AC (d), carried: the LCLI-525 sequence runs end to end -- the refusal, then a rerun, then a verified removal.

LCLI-699 retention/ordering and hint fix, carried: clearPendingQuestMigration runs AFTER the removal resolves, so a refused --remove-backlog keeps its pending record; and the refusal hint names COMMIT as the only recovery that keeps the rerun idempotent, dropping the discarded clean/git-checkout arm.
docs/reference/cli-surface.md:217 drops the clause or clean it from the refusal recovery, so the docs match the corrected code hint.

(4ap) durable-status keying: a rerun, with or without --remove-backlog, runs at most ONE read-only preview to compute the current digest and then asks Quest migration backlog status --digest <digest>; the local pending record is a cache only, never the gate. Applied -> exit 0, existing receipt plus alreadyApplied: true, nothing applied; with --remove-backlog then the verified archive, verify, remove. No receipt -> a genuinely fresh migration.

(4ap)(a) confirmed hint: on a successful apply, lore records the LAST APPLIED migrationDigest as a hint in its own init state; on a rerun, a current digest that DIFFERS from a hint which status(hint) confirms applied refuses with backlog.diverged-from-migration, applying nothing. No hint, or an unconfirmed hint, is FRESH; the hint is never the gate on its own, and Quest alias-collision refusal remains the backstop against a double apply.
The post-migration notice truthfully names --remove-backlog as the next step for a completed no-removal migration.

(4as) option-sensitivity: Quest preview digest is option-sensitive, so the divergence refusal remedy names BOTH causes -- backlog/ changed since the recorded migration (restore it), or this rerun migration options differ from the original run (rerun with the original flags, e.g. --preserve-source-ids). No new hint state is added. A test covers the flags-differ case on UNCHANGED bytes.
The rollback remedy names --actor and --actor-kind so quest migration backlog rollback runs as printed.

Tests and gates: the LCLI-700 repro runs end to end (migrate without removal, pending cleared, rerun with --remove-backlog -> exit 0, alreadyApplied, verified removal), covering the mechanism LCLI-700 itself carries; and bun test, lint, typecheck and lore check all exit 0.

implementationNotes: Runs OUTSIDE opum-control under DEC-172 (4ad)/(4as): LCLI-699 job-15olfdi holds lore-cli only consumer slot (MAX_PER_REPO=1), so no open dispatch slot exists for LCLI-700 and its journal review evidence is missing. Review proceeds through review-assignment directly under (4ad). LCLI-699 closes as SUPERSEDED by this task under (4as).

Verdict trail. implement-assignment PASS at 38b7beef (one commit, 6 files; checks green). review-assignment round 1: changes-requested — a MAJOR (the divergence remedy rollback arm did not work, because the digest comparison ran before status) plus F1, a conformance defect against (4ap)(a): an unconfirmed record whose digest has ALSO diverged must go FRESH, not refuse; plus three minors. Fix commit e921537a: status(recorded) is asked BEFORE the digest comparison, digests are compared only on a CONFIRMED receipt, and an unconfirmed record goes fresh whatever the digest; the three minors fixed too (cli-surface applies-nothing wording, backlog-cli-contract names the durable hint, .gitignore covers the migration state files). Confirmatory check #1 BLOCKED on a NEW MAJOR the reorder introduced — it dropped assertReceipt on the confirmed path, so a non-applied receipt could be reported as applied and could authorise the removal; restored assertReceipt(recordedPreview, confirmed.receipt) plus a mutation-verified test. Confirmatory re-check on e921537a: CONFIRMED. verify-assignment: PASS, 12 of 12 criteria. A final .quest-only reconcile commit c6af58bf set the branch tracker to dev (the branch stale .quest would otherwise have reverted dev LCLI-693 through 700 stamps and deleted LCLI-701/702). Landed from c6af58bf.
finalSummary: Migration idempotence keys on Quest durable status (DEC-172 (4ap)/(4ap)(a)/(4as)), carrying LCLI-699 reviewer-cleared core. Implemented on fix/LCLI-700-durable-status from 7a377d3b; reviewed through review-assignment with one fix round; verified PASS 12 of 12; landed via a new PR into dev. Full verdict trail in the implementation note.
